12 Cybersecurity Companies in Austin to Know

These Austin companies are putting your digital security at the forefront of their businesses.

Written by Built In Staff
Computer screen, coffee or cyber security woman hacker in dark room for coding.
UPDATED BY
Abel Rodriguez | Sep 09, 2026
REVIEWED BY
Ellen Glover
Summary: Austin is home to a growing cybersecurity sector, with companies developing AI-powered tools for threat detection, identity security, cloud protection, blockchain security and fraud prevention. This list highlights leading employers helping organizations defend against evolving cyber threats.

With major data leaks and malicious digital threats in the news on a near-daily basis, the need for cutting-edge cybersecurity is more apparent than ever. On an individual level, cyberthreats can damage one’s financial and personal life. On a broader economic level, companies are losing billions of dollars every year to cyber threats. Fortunately, Austin tech is leading the charge with some of the most innovative solutions to stopping cybercrime in its tracks. Here’s a few of them.

Top Cybersecurity Companies in Austin 
SailPoint
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2005

Cybersecurity Services: Enterprise identity governance, access administration, automated privilege controls

What they do: SailPoint’s unified identity security platform manages access permissions to data and systems for enterprises in regulated sectors like healthcare and finance. The company delivers identity governance and administration (IGA) tools that enforce least-privilege policies through automated access decisions. By continuously adapting security controls across user lifecycle events, SailPoint aims to reduce identity-based attack surfaces and mitigates insider risks.

SailPoint is Hiring | View 111 Jobs

 

CrowdStrike
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2011

Cybersecurity Services: Endpoint protection, managed detection and response (MDR), cloud security, threat intelligence

What they do: CrowdStrike is  best known for its AI-powered Falcon platform, which helps organizations prevent, detect and respond to cyber attacks across endpoints, cloud environments and identities. By combining real-time threat intelligence, behavioral analytics and managed detection and response services, the company helps security teams to identify threats and stop attacks before they spread.

CrowdStrike is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

Closinglock
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2017

Cybersecurity Services: Real estate wire fraud prevention, secure payment portals, identity verification

What they do: Closinglock is an cybersecurity and fintech company that protects the real estate industry from wire fraud through an integrated platform. Its SecurePay digital payment tool, developed in partnership with JP Morgan, enables secure fund transfers. Meanwhile, its secure wire instruction portal and identity verification capabilities protect title companies, attorneys and settlement teams from sophisticated fraud attacks.

Closinglock is Hiring | View 3 Jobs

 

Forcepoint
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 1994

Cybersecurity Services: Data loss prevention, user behavioral analysis, automated threat detection

What they do: Forcepoint aims to help enterprises protect sensitive information across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments. The company utilizes risk-adaptive prevention and behavioral analysis to detect unrecognized threats and adjust security controls automatically based on user behavior. By combining continuous threat detection with dynamic data protection, Forcepoint secures critical assets as data moves across complex corporate networks.

Forcepoint is Hiring | View 29 Jobs

 

Lansweeper
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2004

Cybersecurity Services: IT asset management

What they do: Lansweeper helps IT and cybersecurity teams see all of their IT assets, identify what’s at risk and helps them address those vulnerabilities. The company’s platform can automatically discover and inventory a wide range of assets, including computers, network equipment and IoT devices. The Belgian company has an office in north Austin, close to The Arboretum and The Domain. 

Lansweeper is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

Framework Security
VIEW PROFILE

Founded: 2019

Cybersecurity Services: Penetration testing, risk compliance, vCISO, SOC 2, managed security

What they do: Framework Security specializes in penetration testing, risk and compliance assessment, virtual CISO services, SOC 2 compliance and managed security services. The company takes a proactive approach to cybersecurity, working with organizations to identify vulnerabilities and implement preventive measures against digital threats including social engineering attacks. And its team offers an embedded advisory model featuring weekly working sessions and paired engineers, delivering comprehensive cybersecurity plans.

Framework Security is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

Cloudflare
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2009

Cybersecurity Services: DDoS protection, web application firewall (WAF), zero trust security, secure content delivery

What they do: Cloudflare operates one of the world’s largest global networks, helping businesses improve both the security and performance of their websites, applications and internet services. Its platform blocks distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, filters malicious traffic through a web application firewall and provides zero trust tools that verify users before granting access to corporate resources, helping organizations defend against cyber threats while maintaining fast, reliable connectivity.

Cloudflare is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

NSS Labs
VIEW PROFILE

Founded: 2007

Cybersecurity Services: Continuous security control validation, exploit testing, AI system evaluations

What they do: NSS Labs is an independent cybersecurity testing and validation firm that aims to deliver rigorous, evidence-based evaluations of security products and AI systems against real-world threats. Through its Minion platform, the company provides continuous control validation powered by AI-enabled testing across thousands of exploits, evasion techniques and malware samples to measure security effectiveness and compliance assurance.

NSS Labs is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

Unit 410
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2018

Cybersecurity Services: Blockchain key security, proof-of-stake validator security, network hardening

What they do: Unit 410 is a senior infrastructure engineering company operating some of the largest proof-of-stake validators and securing critical blockchain assets across multiple networks. It specializes in designing and scaling proof-of-stake networks while addressing their inherent security challenges. Unit 410 frequently serves as an early participant in new networks, helping them achieve more secure, efficient operations.

Unit 410 is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

Praetorian
VIEW PROFILE

Founded: 2008

Cybersecurity Services: Offensive security, vulnerability remediation, automated breach prevention

What they do: Praetorian is an offensive cybersecurity company helping enterprises prevent breaches before they occur. Its Guard platform combines agentic AI, workflow automation and offensive security capabilities to identify exploitable vulnerabilities and guide their remediation. Using an adversarial perspective, Praetorian reveals material risks the way attackers would, enabling organizations to prioritize their cybersecurity investments for maximum risk reduction.

Praetorian is Hiring | View 5 Jobs

 

Living Security
VIEW PROFILE

Founded: 2017

Cybersecurity Services: Human risk management, gamified awareness training, phishing threat prevention

What they do: Living Security produces AI-native software that helps organizations measure and reduce workforce cybersecurity risk. The platform empowers end-users to broaden their cybersecurity awareness and create lasting behavioral change through gamification and immersive training techniques designed to combat threats like phishing.

Living Security is Hiring | View All Jobs

 

Rapid7
VIEW PROFILE
We are hiring

Founded: 2000

Cybersecurity Services: Vulnerability tracking, cloud security monitoring, managed detection and response (MDR)

What they do: Rapid7 is a cybersecurity firm providing AI-driven technology to safeguard digital environments against evolving threats. Its unified platform continuously tracks security exposures across cloud systems and user activity to uncover potential vulnerabilities. Backed by dedicated threat research, the company also delivers 24/7 managed detection and response (MDR) to provide ongoing operational protection for organizations worldwide.

Rapid7 is Hiring | View 36 Jobs
